info.title: Agent Bank API
info.summary: Programmable, non-custodial bank accounts for AI agents.
info.description: Money is a decimal string plus an asset code. Ids are prefixed (`org_`, `agt_`, `acct_`, `pay_`, `esc_`). Every write takes an `Idempotency-Key`. Errors follow RFC 9457. Testnet (Base Sepolia) only.

sessionSignature.description: HTTP Message Signature (RFC 9421) by the agent's session key. Send `Signature-Input` and `Signature` (label `agentbank`, alg `eip191-secp256k1`, keyid = session id) plus `Content-Digest` for bodies. The SDKs do this for you.
